summary: End-to-end testing of Sawyer & Co. institutional site. Backend: 8/8 pytest cases passed (root, inquiry CRUD for all 4 categories, persistence verification, and 422 validation for category/email/message/required fields). Frontend: All 7 environments present, institutional nav transitions to frosted on scroll, both founders present (anwar + sarah), 3 nexus nodes present, ACCESS PORTAL and capital-gateway-btn correctly link to https://zephyrtrustai.com, $XX.X B+ placeholder metric rendered, harbour-rooster silhouette present, nav scroll navigation works for advisory and capital-suite, inquiry form submission flow completes successfully and renders inquiry-success state with success toast. No page errors.

minor.issue: module-level logger is referenced inside _send_inquiry_email/submit_inquiry but the logger global is defined after these functions in server.py — works at request-time but is fragile; recommend moving logger setup near the top of the module

action_items: Optional: relocate logging.basicConfig / logger initialization above the route functions in /app/backend/server.py so module-load failures (e.g., empty RESEND_API_KEY warning path) don't NameError
critical_code_review_comments: server.py: logger is defined at module bottom but referenced inside _send_inquiry_email and submit_inquiry — currently safe because functions run after module import, but should be hoisted above route definitions for robustness.
Backend correctly excludes MongoDB _id from list responses via projection {'_id': 0}.
Frontend correctly uses process.env.REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL (no hardcoded URL).
All interactive elements carry data-testid attributes — excellent testability.
seed_data_creation: Created TEST_-prefixed inquiries in MongoDB inquiries collection (5 total: 1 Advisory persistence test + 3 categories + 1 from frontend submission test). Safe to leave; can be cleaned up later by deleting docs where name starts with 'TEST '.
context_for_next_testing_agent: All 8 backend tests in /app/backend/tests/test_inquiry.py pass. Frontend e2e (env DOM presence, nav, links, founders, rooster, inquiry submission) all pass. Resend may silently fail to deliver in test mode to inquiries@sawyerandco.com but inquiry still persists and 200 is returned — verified. No retest required unless main agent changes routes or form schema.
